payload.title: Measure the Engage funnel and keep campaign attribution to the lead
payload.description:
Machines on Machines traffic reaches anth.us but the Engage funnel cannot be measured step by step, and the house-ad UTM tags are lost when the visitor moves from the landing page to Engage, so leads in Prospectus carry an empty campaign.

Scenario: Funnel events
  Given a visitor on /engage/
  When the form loads, they first type, they send a new note, and the intake accepts it
  Then GA4 receives engage_view, lead_form_start, lead_form_submit and generate_lead, each with form_id, lead_source and solution only

Scenario: Failures are visible
  Given the intake fails or refuses a note
  Then GA4 receives lead_form_error with error_kind, and never the visitor text

Scenario: Campaign survives the hop
  Given a visitor lands on /ai-solutions/?utm_source=machines-on-machines&utm_medium=house-ad&utm_campaign=busywork
  When they follow an Engage link and send a note
  Then the note campaign is utm_source machines-on-machines, utm_medium house-ad, utm_campaign busywork

Scenario: Referral without UTM
  Given a visitor arrives from another site with no UTM tags
  Then the note campaign is utm_source <referring host>, utm_medium referral
